# Customer Portal Requirements Quality Checklist: customer-portal-upgrade

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of requirements for the Customer Portal Upgrade prior to execution
**Created**: 2026-09-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are all unauthenticated gate and authentication failure states specified with clear visual layout expectations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Are the exact fields and formats displayed in the customer identity header (display name, email, role badge) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 - Are table availability search input constraints (restaurant selection, date limits, time intervals, guest count bounds) fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 - Are the rules for auto-populating the ±1 hour arrival window specified when table capacity is unavailable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 - Are the trigger conditions and event data payload structures for the Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream documented for all supported event types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §1.5]
- [x] CHK006 - Are the visible fields and lifecycle actions on active reservation cards (restaurant, date, time, party size, status, cancel button) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 - Are the visible fields and lifecycle actions on active waiting list cards (restaurant, date, arrival window, party size, leave queue button) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Unambiguity

- [x] CHK008 - Is the "instant booking" flow clarified to specify whether a confirmation dialog or immediate click action executes the reservation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the 15-minute waiting list offer countdown behavior specified with exact second-level tick updates and expiration handling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK010 - Is "timely feedback" quantified with specific maximum visual feedback latency thresholds for search and booking actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 - Are authorized customer role identifiers unambiguously defined across both token claim paths (`realm_access.roles` and `resource_access`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications §Session]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the distinction between cancellation notice eligibility and ineligibility stated with concrete hourly thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013]

## 3. Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Do restaurant selection requirements in the search form align with the dynamic catalog availability in existing backend services? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 - Are waiting list status values (`WAITING`, `OFFERED`, `CONVERTED`, `EXPIRED`, `CANCELLED`) consistently referenced across spec, data model, and API contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §1.4]
- [x] CHK015 - Do reservation status values and cancellation rules in the portal match the authoritative lifecycle rules in `reservation-service`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the waiting list card dynamically removed from the active view upon successful cancellation of the entry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK017 - Is an explicit 15-minute countdown timer defined for waiting list offers, matching the waiting-list-service expiry TTL? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Architecture]
- [x] CHK018 - Does the SSE stream endpoint match the actual notification-service endpoint path (`/api/v1/notifications/stream`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Contracts]
- [x] CHK019 - Are notification payloads defined for reservation confirmations and waiting list offers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Contracts]
- [x] CHK020 - Is an SSE heartbeat/keepalive mechanism specified to prevent connection drops across Spring Cloud Gateway? [Resilience, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Technical Decisions]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the countdown timer displayed in mm:ss format with urgent visual styling when under 2 minutes remaining? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the UI behavior specified for when SSE fails to connect or disconnects unexpectedly (reconnection backoff, manual refresh banner)? [Resilience, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Frontend Architecture]
- [x] CHK023 - Are cross-service data consistency rules documented for concurrent modifications (e.g. reservation cancelled while manager inspects it)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 - Are edge cases defined for when a customer accepts an expired offer or an already-claimed table? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for when an offer expires while the customer is actively viewing the offer card (countdown reaching 00:00)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 - Are security requirements specified to ensure sensitive bearer tokens are never exposed in browser URLs, logs, or unencrypted storage? [Security, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements (ARIA live regions for countdowns, keyboard navigable modal dialogs, accessible form labels) explicitly documented? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 - Are response latency and initial load time budgets specified for the customer portal single-page application? [Performance, Spec §SC-002, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK029 - Are backend resource boundaries and connection timeout handling for `SseEmitter` instances in `notification-service` explicitly defined? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Gap]

## 7. Dependencies & Integration Quality

- [x] CHK030 - Are Spring Cloud Gateway routing rules for both `/ui/customer/**` static assets and `/api/v1/notifications/stream` SSE endpoints explicitly defined? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK031 - Are Kafka event topic names and schema consumption requirements in `notification-service` verified against platform event contracts? [Integration, Spec §FR-019, Research §3]
- [x] CHK032 - Are dependencies on Keycloak realm `rube-goldberg` client configuration documented and validated? [Dependency, Assumptions]
